record.paper_title:
AIM Workshop “Pólya-Schur-Lax Problems: Hyperbolicity and Stability
Preservers” — A List of Open Problems
record.original_question:
Characterize all real polynomials p_n(x) of degree n whose zeros all
lie in the interval (-1,1) and whose associated
polynomial φ_n(x) = Σ_{k=0}^{⌊n/2⌋} p_n^{(2k)}(1) x^k has only real
negative zeros.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For each integer $n\ge 1$, let $p_n(x)$ be a real polynomial of degree $n$ all of whose zeros lie in the open interval $(-1,1)$. Define the associated polynomial
$$\varphi_n(x) \;=\; \sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor} p_n^{(2k)}(1)\, x^{k},$$
where $p_n^{(j)}(1)$ denotes the $j$-th derivative of $p_n$ evaluated at $1$. Characterize all such polynomials $p_n(x)$ with the property that $\varphi_n(x)$ has only real, strictly negative zeros.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in standard open-problem lists on zeros of polynomials and stability preservers (a Pólya–Schur–Lax type question). A direct web search did not surface a published full characterization; related work by Craven–Csordas and others addresses partial results and special cases but no complete answer is documented.

status_evidence.title: Complex Zero Decreasing Sequences — Craven, Csordas
status_evidence.snippet: Survey-type discussion of operators and sequences preserving real-zero properties; characterization questions of this type are stated as open.
status_evidence.claim: Related characterization problems involving associated polynomials and real-zero preservation are discussed without a complete answer.

status_evidence.title: Linear operators and the distribution of zeros of entire functions
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Pólya–Schur–Lax problems including questions about associated polynomials with prescribed zero distribution.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization of polynomials whose associated derivative polynomial has only real negative zeros remains an open problem in this area.
